title: Initialized constant cells
statement: For any word size $W$ and initial memory function $m : \mathbb{Z} \to \{0,1\}^W$, executing the three-instruction initialization sequence leaves the cells at addresses $-5$, $-7$, and $-9$ containing the word representations of $1$, $0$, and $-1$, respectively.
